_comment: The upstream commit each bundled submodule is pinned to.
Pharos is a detached copy of Zotero with no git metadata, and inside the
monorepo `git rev-parse HEAD` in a submodule directory resolves to the
PARENT repository's HEAD -- which changes on every unrelated commit. The
build uses these hashes to fetch the prebuilt artefacts Zotero publishes,
which are keyed by exactly these commits, so getting them wrong means
building each module from source instead.
Taken from the gitlinks of the upstream release this client is based on.
Update them together with the submodule contents, never separately: a pin
that names a different commit than the sources present would download an
artefact built from other code and nothing would report the mismatch.
